answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 11 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 785 identities costs 785 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The tundra of the quote is the proof, the trellis of the refresh is the expiry, and the nadir of the burn is the penalty.
